source_reported_context.disclaimer: These values come from pinned research files at 16 kHz on 30 DNS2020 pairs and a separate C++ scheduled backend. They are not reproduced here, not device timing, not this fixture's metrics, not a listening result and not a release claim.
source_reported_context.scope: Pinned research provenance only; not reproduced, not pooled and not used as a threshold.

streaming_boundary.availability_model: sample-coordinate only; no wall clock, device clock or deadline
streaming_boundary.declared_lag_provenance: Pinned adapter README reports a consistent 640-sample (40 ms) output lag across 30 DNS files for the dpdfnet 0.6.0 streaming API; source-reported, not re-measured here.
streaming_boundary.flush_policy: A partial final frame is zero-padded only for gain estimation; its valid samples are emitted, then the delay line is drained exactly once.

output_accounting.finding: The pinned adapter wrapper drops 640 samples, appends 640 zeros and truncates to input length. In this model the first 640 raw samples are startup zeros, the last 640 real samples arrive only through flush, and the appended tail zeros are truncated, so valid_samples=len(output) is consistent only after a complete flush.

streaming_boundary.protocol: caller-supplied external asset plus stateful chunked frame calls
streaming_boundary.reset_policy: Explicit reset clears all state and buffers; replay is bit-identical.

title: DPDFNet-2 streaming
tool_provenance: DPDFNet-2 model, dpdfnet 0.6.0 package and ONNX runtime are absent; nothing was downloaded, installed, loaded or invoked.
The model digest, byte count, source revision, mutable download revision and license metadata are quoted from research/noise_suppression_assets_20261027.json and the pinned adapter README.
The 640-sample lag and reported pilot metrics are pinned research provenance only; this package models a 640-sample lag and does not measure any latency.
